name: Biological and Biomedical Sciences (BBS)
tracks: Biochemistry, Quantitative Biology, Biophysics and Structural Biology
Molecular Cell Biology, Genetics, and Development
Translational Molecular Medicine, Pharmacology, and Physiology
summary: One application is the gateway to 12 Yale PhD programs. You apply to one of nine Tracks; first-year students rotate through three labs and join a thesis lab toward the end of the first year.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The BBS application page gives December 1, 2026; the Graduate School's program page gives 11:59 pm Eastern.

timeline.interviews: Each Track contacts the applicants it wants to interview in December or early January. Interviewed applicants may then be invited to visit campus in February; the page still lists last season's (2026) visit dates.
timeline.decisions: Most decisions are sent by the Graduate School between late January and early March. Admitted students decide by April 15.

english.note: TOEFL or IELTS if your native language isn't English. There is no IELTS minimum, but an IELTS Speaking score of 7.5 or below means taking Yale's English language program in August before you start. Not needed with an undergraduate degree from a college where English is the main language of instruction, after at least three years of study there. Take the test no later than November and within 24 months of applying.

applicationFee.note: US citizens, permanent residents and non-US citizens can all request a waiver, for financial hardship or programs such as the Pell Grant, AmeriCorps or Peace Corps. Request it separately, well before the deadline; a reply takes 2 to 3 business days.

documents: Statement of academic purpose (500 to 1,000 words)
Unofficial transcripts from every college attended
requirements.note: Apply to one Track only. There is no minimum GPA, but grades in science and math courses are read carefully. You don't need to find an adviser before applying; Plant Molecular Biology applicants are strongly encouraged to contact a faculty member first. Don't send a writing sample.

funding.note: Full tuition, free health insurance for you and your family, and discounted dental insurance, for all BBS students regardless of citizenship. Money for students who are not US citizens or permanent residents is very limited, so only a small share of international applicants can be admitted.

international.note: Only a small percentage of international applicants are admitted, because funding for them is very limited.
